ARI is an advocacy organization, not a regulator. Its proposal was covered26Oct and builds on an earlier2026blueprint. Quarterly confidential filings plus FOUR BUSINESS DAYS for material-change reporting are proposed, not enacted; no such office or powers are established by the proposal. Scope thresholds10^26trainingFLOP AND$100million prior-yearaggregateAI-training spend are earlier proposed coverage tests. Detailed fields need rulemaking. Disclosure/DOJreferrals,FOIAexemption andwhistleblower provisions are proposed. Claims about nonexistent powers mean under this proposed scheme, not that existing government powers vanish. Safety, costs, comparability and adoption remain open. Illustration is fictional. Rendered mathematical superscripts may repeat in the text capture; the proposed compute threshold is 10^26 FLOP, as stated in this note.

ARI是倡议组织，非监管机构。提案于10月26日获报道，建立在2026年较早蓝图上。季度保密报告、重大变化后四个工作日通报皆属提议，尚未生效；提案本身并未创设机构或权力。10^26次训练浮点运算与过去一年累计一亿美元AI训练支出，是早期蓝图拟议的双门槛，非现行法律。细目需后续规则制定。司法部移送、FOIA豁免、举报机制皆是建议。“不存在的权力”等表述仅指此拟议制度，并非否认政府已有职权。安全性、成本、可比性及是否获采纳仍开放。插画为想象。 渲染数学上标可能在文字采集中重复；拟议算力门槛为10^26次浮点运算，以本说明为准。
